blocks.speaker: narrator
blocks.text: King Nebuchadnezzar made himself an image of gold, sixty cubits high, and set it up on the plain of Dura. When the music played, everybody had to fall down and worship it. Anybody who would not bow would be thrown into a burning fiery furnace that same hour.

blocks.speaker: narrator
blocks.text: Three young Hebrew men who served the king would not bow: Shadrach, Meshach, and Abed-nego. Somebody told on them. The king was full of rage, and he had them brought in.

verses.text: Now if ye be ready that at what time ye hear the sound of the cornet, flute, harp, sackbut, psaltery, and dulcimer, and all kinds of musick, ye fall down and worship the image which I have made; well: but if ye worship not, ye shall be cast the same hour into the midst of a burning fiery furnace; and who is that God that shall deliver you out of my hands?

segments.speaker: nebuchadnezzar
segments.text: Now if ye be ready that at what time ye hear the sound of the cornet, flute, harp, sackbut, psaltery, and dulcimer, and all kinds of musick, ye fall down and worship the image which I have made; well: but if ye worship not, ye shall be cast the same hour into the midst of a burning fiery furnace; and who is that God that shall deliver you out of my hands?

blocks.speaker: narrator
blocks.text: Who is that God? That is the question on the table. Now listen to how those three young men answered.

verses.text: Shadrach, Meshach, and Abed-nego, answered and said to the king, O Nebuchadnezzar, we are not careful to answer thee in this matter.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: Shadrach, Meshach, and Abed-nego, answered and said to the king,

segments.speaker: the-three
segments.text: O Nebuchadnezzar, we are not careful to answer thee in this matter.

verses.text: If it be so, our God whom we serve is able to deliver us from the burning fiery furnace, and he will deliver us out of thine hand, O king.

segments.speaker: the-three
segments.text: If it be so, our God whom we serve is able to deliver us from the burning fiery furnace, and he will deliver us out of thine hand, O king.

verses.text: But if not, be it known unto thee, O king, that we will not serve thy gods, nor worship the golden image which thou hast set up.

segments.speaker: the-three
segments.text: But if not, be it known unto thee, O king, that we will not serve thy gods, nor worship the golden image which thou hast set up.

blocks.speaker: narrator
blocks.text: But if not. Church, some of the strongest faith in the Bible lives in those three little words. They believed God was able. They did not claim to know what God would do. And they made up their minds ahead of time that they would not bow either way.

blocks.speaker: narrator
blocks.text: The king got so mad his face changed. He told them to heat the furnace seven times hotter than usual. Strong men from his army tied up those three, still in their coats and hats, and threw them in.

verses.text: Then Nebuchadnezzar the king was astonied, and rose up in haste, and spake, and said unto his counsellors, Did not we cast three men bound into the midst of the fire? They answered and said unto the king, True, O king.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: Then Nebuchadnezzar the king was astonied, and rose up in haste, and spake, and said unto his counsellors,

segments.speaker: nebuchadnezzar
segments.text: Did not we cast three men bound into the midst of the fire?

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: They answered and said unto the king, True, O king.

verses.text: He answered and said, Lo, I see four men loose, walking in the midst of the fire, and they have no hurt; and the form of the fourth is like the Son of God.

segments.speaker: nebuchadnezzar
segments.text: Lo, I see four men loose, walking in the midst of the fire, and they have no hurt; and the form of the fourth is like the Son of God.

blocks.speaker: narrator
blocks.text: Four. They went in three, and the king counted four. The old folks would tell you he did not keep them out of the fire. He met them in it.

blocks.speaker: narrator
blocks.text: The king came near the door of that furnace and called them out by name. They walked out. Not a hair on their heads was burned. Their coats were not scorched. They did not even smell like smoke.

verses.text: Then Nebuchadnezzar spake, and said, Blessed be the God of Shadrach, Meshach, and Abed-nego, who hath sent his angel, and delivered his servants that trusted in him, and have changed the king’s word, and yielded their bodies, that they might not serve nor worship any god, except their own God.

segments.speaker: nebuchadnezzar
segments.text: Blessed be the God of Shadrach, Meshach, and Abed-nego, who hath sent his angel, and delivered his servants that trusted in him, and have changed the king’s word, and yielded their bodies, that they might not serve nor worship any god, except their own God.

blocks.speaker: narrator
blocks.text: A king who started the day building an idol ended it blessing the God of three young men who would not bow. Their faith was not loud. It was steady. And when they stood in that fire, they were not by themselves.

pastor.note: 'But if not' kept without promising rescue; no speculation on who the fourth man was.

cultural.note: Steady, dignified young men; the elders' saying used once.
